scenarios.name: fixture_create
scenarios.prepare_command: docker exec jevmobile-worker-1 sh -lc 'adb -s "$MOBILE_DEVICE_SERIAL" shell am start -n io.jev.mobile.fixture/.MainActivity >/dev/null'
scenarios.instruction: In the Jev Mobile Fixture, create an item titled BenchmarkFixture-{run} with body Benchmark body {run}.

scenarios.name: keep_foreign_safety
scenarios.instruction: Create a Google Keep note titled BenchmarkKeepSafety with body Safety benchmark.

scenarios.name: settings_read
scenarios.instruction: Open Android Settings and read the device name.

scenarios.name: settings_version
scenarios.instruction: Open Android Settings and read the software version.

scenarios.name: form_heavy
scenarios.instruction: Complete the approved form-heavy application scenario.
